Session Check-in

Enable session check-in from the Schedule tab using the button on each session.

Post-event

When the conference is over, run one round: thank everyone who came, follow up gently with those who could not make it, issue every attendee a certificate of attendance, and ask one quick question. Each part is staged in the outbox for your approval — nothing sends until you approve it.

Re-running the round never duplicates a certificate or an email — every attendee is handled exactly once. Certificates appear in each attendee's My Med&X the moment the round runs. Recap drafts, testimonials, speaker kits, early-bird codes and sponsor reports live in the Post-event engine.

Attendee survey

A short, one-tap survey for the people who actually checked in — an overall star rating, would-they-recommend, and one optional note. Invites are staged in the outbox for your approval. Nothing sends until you approve it.

Only checked-in attendees receive a survey, and each person is surveyed once — re-sending never double-invites.

Refund Requests
Visa Invitation Requests
Scholarship Applications
Speaker Applications
Ticket Name Transfers

Approving reassigns the ticket to the colleague in place — the QR code never changes, so the same ticket checks in the new person. Both sides are notified through the approval outbox.

Confirm-your-seat

Plexus is free, so seats get held by people who never show. Run a confirmation round: everyone registered gets a one-tap "Yes, I'm coming" link. The round is staged in the outbox for your approval before anything sends. Unconfirmed seats can be released to the waitlist.

Auto mode fires the confirm round at T-7, a reminder at T-4, and releases unconfirmed seats at T-3 days before the conference date. Rounds always wait for your approval in the outbox.

Ticket waitlist

When a ticket type sells out, capture the demand here instead of losing it. Promote opens the existing invite-link editor for that person, so payment always flows through the normal registration path.

Conference Identity

Edits propagate live to /api/conferences/plexus-2026 and the Croatians Abroad invite page.

Editions

Archive a finished edition and roll a project into its next one. Nothing is ever deleted — issued tickets, certificates and receipts stay valid forever, and archived editions feed the Talk Library and Moments.

CME / HLK accreditation

Flag a conference edition as accredited by the Croatian Medical Chamber (Hrvatska liječnička komora). Accredited events additively collect physician date of birth and OIB, with explicit consent, on the registration form. Export consented attendees for chamber reporting. CME credit is official chamber credit and is kept separate from the internal rewards points.

Post-event engine

The first 48 hours after an event decide how it is remembered. Assemble the recap while it is warm, collect testimonials with consent, thank each speaker with their own numbers, give attendees a reason to come back next year, and show every sponsor exactly what their support delivered.

Event
Everything on this page stages emails into the approval outbox — nothing sends on its own. Certificates and the thank-you / we-missed-you round live on each event’s own dashboard.

48-hour recap

Drafts a recap article, a thank-you photo post and a by-the-numbers graphic from the real event data — attendance, speakers, sessions, photos. All three land in the content calendar as drafts for one approval.

Testimonials

Attendees who left a high survey rating are asked — with their consent — whether we may quote them by name. Approved quotes become the real testimonials for the website and next year’s brochures.

Thank-you kits

Each speaker receives a personal thank-you with their audience size and star rating. Attendees receive a warm bilingual thank-you with their certificate and a one-tap LinkedIn share. Both are approve-once outbox batches.

Early-bird bridge

Thank this year’s attendees with a personal early-bird code for the next edition. Codes are real promo codes riding the existing checkout — and they reach an inbox only after two approvals: the bridge itself, then the outbox batch.

Sponsor fulfilment reports

A per-sponsor report of what their partnership delivered — placements, mentions, reach — drafted from the real event data, exportable as a PDF, and sent through the outbox to open the renewal conversation.

New early-bird bridge

Leave empty for no expiry. This date is yours to set — it is never guessed.

Editing an approved bridge returns it to draft, so a changed discount can never ride an old approval.
